platform_difference: Each result matches its own immutable Python oracle. Native path spelling and ordering deliberately preserve platform-specific diagnostics, so Windows and Linux combined trace hashes differ.

unicode: Explicit Python word/whitespace classes, CRLF-aware splitlines, printable-string quoting and Nd decimal conversion; pinned regex supplies the Unicode database. Real vendor artifacts are ASCII.
